asset_description:
The FastAPI layer exposes all of this over REST, handling file uploads (DFDs), retrieving GitHub repos with tree-sitter chunking, and metrics for real-time playback that scrubs through the simulation timeline.
DFD Components: User/Patient, Admin/Medical Staff, FastAPI Web Server, PostgreSQL Database, File Storage/Uploads, Metrics Collector, Code Chunker Service, ChromaDB Vector Store, GitHub Repository, Real-time Client, Simulation Timeline, Threat Analysis Engine, DFD Upload Service
DFD Flows: User sends HTTPS/REST to FastAPI Web Server; Admin sends HTTPS/REST to FastAPI Web Server

vulnerabilities.title: SQL Injection in Patient Data Queries
vulnerabilities.description: The triage system's database queries for patient data may be vulnerable to SQL injection attacks if user input is not properly sanitized.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Implement parameterized queries and input validation for all database interactions

vulnerabilities.title: Unencrypted PII in File Storage
vulnerabilities.description: Patient personal information may be stored in unencrypted file uploads, violating HIPAA compliance requirements.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Implement encryption at rest for all file storage containing PII

vulnerabilities.title: Missing Rate Limiting on API Endpoints
vulnerabilities.description: FastAPI endpoints lack rate limiting, making them vulnerable to DoS attacks and resource exhaustion.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Implement rate limiting middleware on all public API endpoints

top_vulnerabilities.title: SQL Injection in Patient Data Queries

attack_paths.entry_point: Malicious user exploits unvalidated input in patient search API
intermediate_steps: Craft SQL injection payload targeting patient data tables
Bypass authentication checks through SQL manipulation
Extract sensitive patient information including SSN and medical records
attack_paths.impact: Complete breach of patient confidentiality, HIPAA violation

intermediate_steps: Upload malicious file disguised as medical document
Exploit lack of file type validation
Execute server-side code through unrestricted file upload
Send massive number of requests to resource-intensive endpoints
Exhaust server resources due to missing rate limiting
Cause service unavailability for legitimate medical staff

graph TD

    WebApp -->|Metrics/Logs| Metrics[Metrics Collector]

    WebApp -->|GitHub API| GitHub[GitHub Repository]
